decision: User designated the evaluated RW20000 position-only Head / free-feet fit as the current research baseline.
body_observation_loss: dual-view calibrated 2D reprojection, normalized Huber; no triangulated body 3D residual
head_constraints: 3D Head position soft anchor only. Neck and Head local rotations fixed at identity relative to their parents.
initialization: Template pose and mean shape. Per-frame stereo shoulders and hips initialize root rotation; same four points via reprojection on unstable rays. Initial translation matches the Head point.
shape_policy: reference experiment has zero-rank shape basis and fixed mean shape; shape optimization requires a separately identified variant
hand_policy: no WiLoR hand observation loss in this reference; local hand pose fixed
checkpoint_selection: lowest feasible training objective; no body 3D GT selection
reference_detector: RW20000 epoch 1; exact Sapiens2 base plus trained adapter identified by the checkpoint record.
deployment_status: research baseline designation; legacy EgoSMPLX CLI remains a separate pipeline
limitations: Frozen 100 stereo pairs from S1, S9, S11; not an independent blind test.
Annotation-assisted Head position, session extrinsics and in-image masks.
Fixed fitting budget; only two RW20000 fits pass the strict convergence diagnostic.
Existing research environment and external assets required.
observations: 12 bilateral shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle joints. Reference in-image masks without a confidence threshold.
feet_policy: Free feet with generic pose prior and joint limits. No ground, contact, flat-foot or balance loss.
primary_evaluation: 12-joint per-pair similarity PA and left-camera MPJPE; pooled radial 2D RMSE on original images.
protocol_scope: Effective solver settings. The archived runner constructs the protocol and runs four detector conditions. Only the rw20000 rows define v2.
